description: This PHP source file defines the 'jjwg_Areas' class, which extends 'jjwg_Areas_sugar' and manages geographic area data, including polygons, centroids, areas, and point-in-area calculations within a SugarCRM module context.

classes.name: jjwg_Areas
classes.description: Extends 'jjwg_Areas_sugar', managing geographic area data including polygons, centroids, areas, and spatial relationships within the CRM module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and loads configuration if 'init' is true.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads mapping configuration settings via the 'jjwg_Maps' bean and global settings.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Overrides parent method to retrieve a record and then define polygon, area, and centroid based on stored data.

methods.name: define_polygon
methods.description: Parses the coordinates string to define the polygon vertices as an array of lng/lat/elv points.

methods.name: define_area_loc
methods.description: Returns the geographic location of the area based on centroid, including name.

methods.name: define_centroid
methods.description: Calculates the centroid of the polygon if not already set.

methods.name: define_area
methods.description: Calculates the polygon's area using the shoelace formula.

methods.name: define_loc
methods.description: Defines a location dictionary with name, lat, and lng, defaulting to centroid if not provided.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Checks if longitude is numeric and within -180 to 180 degrees.

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Checks if latitude is numeric and within -90 to 90 degrees.

methods.name: is_marker_in_area
methods.description: Checks if a marker object is within the area polygon.

methods.name: is_point_in_area
methods.description: Checks if specified lng/lat point is inside the polygon area.

methods.name: point_in_polygon
methods.description: Implements the point-in-polygon algorithm to determine if a point lies within the polygon boundary, considering whether points on vertices count as inside.

methods.name: point_on_vertex
methods.description: Checks if a point matches any of the polygon's vertices.

methods.name: point_string_to_coordinates
methods.description: Converts a string of coordinates into an array with x (lng) and y (lat).
